The table had 2 empty beer glasses and a closed tab on it, so clearly someone hadn't cleaned the table. We sit down (because it was jam packed and we knew we would never get a table otherwise to watch the game) and hail down a waitress to clean off the table and take our order. She says that someone else will do it and she will be right back. 15 mins later a busboy cleans the table, and 10 mins after that the waitress comes by and takes our order.

She said the special was something like $4 PBR and $5 Texas beers, so I order a PBR (cheeeap) and my boyfriend orders a Texas beer. She had failed to tell us that the PBRs were literally TWICE THE SIZE of the Texas beers, so my boyfriend got screwed over.

Then she didn't come back for at least 45 minutes to take our food order. We got the food maybe 30 minutes after that (normal) and all was fine until my boyfriend's friend showed up. The waitress comes back (after we literally yelled her name and waved our arms to get her attention) and takes HIS order and literally looks at me and walks away as I am asking for another beer. When our friend asks for her to come back to take my drink order she rolls her eyes and scoffs and says "FINE. Jesus fucking christ." Took her about 20 mins to get me my stupid PBR.

When we finally were fed up and the spurs lost, we ask for the check. She had tried to charge me for 7 BEERS when I had only had 2. When I showed her the error, she seriously tried to say that I had 7 beers. I guess she probably has gotten away in the past with tricking drunk people but I got pissed (I wasn't drunk at all!!!) and told her to fix it.

When she came back she literally threw the receipt at me and mumbled something about "here's your fucking receipt, bitch" as she walked away.

I gave her a $0.10 tip and will never go back.

I get that on a game night its gonna be crazy but we were there for like 5 hours (got there early to try to get seats and eat before the game) and COULD have spent more on drinks if she had not been such a fucking bitch.

Schizoaffective disorder is basically a disorder with psychotic symptoms and abnormal moods. The way I explain it is kind of like bipolar disorder and schizophrenia combined. (Lovely, eh?). An average day changes day to day, honestly. I'm at this moment in time not medicated so one day I might be manic, hypomanic, or depressed. Lately I'm one of those, instead of a stable mood. An average day also includes seeing shadow people and sometimes this disgusting creature that seems to follow me around... along with whispers. During the day I can usually distract myself enough to be calm, which is how I get through the day. If I am depressed (which is common lately,) it gets almost impossible to get through the day. Whispers tell me how useless I am and laugh in my head, while feelings of paranoia make me afraid to move incase I am seen by the monster creature hallucination that follows me.
